description.value: Robert's Lake Regional Park is a nature reserve and regional park situated near Kelowna in British Columbia's Okanagan region. Tagged in OpenStreetMap as a nature reserve, it offers a natural outdoor setting typical of the semi-arid lake country surrounding Kelowna. Touring cyclists passing through the area may find it a scenic detour or rest point along their route.
